datatables_config.title: Mentor Load
datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT 
users.field_full_name_value AS "name_of_mentee",
addon.addon_fields_json->>'skill_code' AS "skill_code",
t.task_display_name AS "task_display_name",
t.tkt_code AS "task_code",
t.task_start_date AS "start_date", 

CASE
  WHEN t.status = 'closed' THEN
    CASE
      WHEN cth.task_hold_days IS NOT NULL THEN
        DATE_PART('day', to_timestamp(t.closed_on) - to_timestamp(t.assigned_on)) - cth.task_hold_days
      ELSE
        DATE_PART('day', to_timestamp(t.closed_on) - to_timestamp(t.assigned_on))
    END
  WHEN t.status = 'open' AND CAST(t.assigned_on as INTEGER) < :time THEN
    CASE
      WHEN cth.task_hold_days IS NOT NULL THEN
        DATE_PART('day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(t.assigned_on)) - cth.task_hold_days
      ELSE
        DATE_PART('day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(t.assigned_on))
    END
  ELSE
    NULL
END as "elapsed_days"

FROM {task_mentor_mapping} as tmm
LEFT JOIN {task} as t ON tmm.task_id = t.task_id
LEFT JOIN {business_object} AS bo ON t.bo_id = bo.bo_id
LEFT JOIN vf_process AS process ON t.pr_id = process.pr_id 
LEFT JOIN vf_wf_tkt_addon_fields AS addon ON addon.wf_id = process.wf_id AND addon.task_name = t.task_name
LEFT JOIN {users_field_data} as user_data ON bo.json_data->>'email' = user_data.mail
LEFT JOIN {user__field_full_name} as users ON  users.entity_id = user_data.uid

LEFT JOIN {view_calculated_task_hold_days} as cth ON t.task_id = cth.task_id
WHERE 

CASE 
        WHEN 'mentee' IN (:user_roles[] ) THEN tmm.mentor_uid = :loggedIn_uid    
    ELSE 1=1
     END
	 AND t.status = 'open'
Order by elapsed_days DESC

datatables_config.title: Tracking
datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT 
bo_wf_mapping.bo_id AS "reference", 
fm.uri AS "custom_full_img", 
fm.uri AS "custom_thumbnail_img", 
'' AS "image_placeholder", 
CONCAT('track-bos-timeline-details/', bo_wf_mapping.bo_id) AS "link", 
CASE WHEN (('wcms_admin'  IN (:user_roles[] )) OR ('planner'  IN (:user_roles[] ))) THEN CONCAT('modify-bo/',bo_wf_mapping.bo_id) ELSE NULL END AS "modify_bo", 
bo.json_data->>'name' AS "name",  
bo.json_data->>'email' AS "email", 
bo.json_data->>'designation' AS "designation", 
bo.json_data->>'team' AS "team", 
bo.json_data->>'goal_path' AS "goal_path", 
process.process_start_dt AS "start_date", 
process.process_end_dt AS "end_date", 
bo.bo_type AS "bo_type", 
bo.bo_color AS "bo_color", 
bo.md1 AS "csr", 
workflow.wf_name AS "workflow", 
MIN(process.pr_id) AS "process_id" 
FROM {process} AS process 
LEFT JOIN {bo_wf_mapping} AS bo_wf_mapping ON process.bo_wf_mapping_id = bo_wf_mapping.id 
LEFT JOIN {workflow} AS workflow ON process.wf_id = workflow.wf_id 
LEFT JOIN {business_object} AS bo ON bo_wf_mapping.bo_id = bo.bo_id 
LEFT JOIN {file_managed} fm ON bo.bo_img_fid = fm.fid 
GROUP BY reference, start_date, end_date, bo_type, bo_color,csr, workflow, name, email, designation, team, goal_path, bo_wf_mapping_id, process.updated, fm.uri 
ORDER BY process.bo_wf_mapping_id DESC, process.updated DESC

CASE
      WHEN feedback_sub.fdbk_hr_remark = '' THEN 'Add Remark'
      ELSE 'Edit Remark'
      END AS "action_btn_disaplay_name"


FROM
(SELECT
feedback.id as id,
feedback.mentee_id AS mentee_id,
feedback.fdbk_date AS fdbk_date,
feedback.fdbk_remark AS fdbk_remark,
feedback.fdbk_hr_remark AS fdbk_hr_remark,

feedback.action_points AS action_points,

CASE
      WHEN feedback_sub.fdbk_hr_remark = '' THEN 'Add Remark'
      ELSE 'Edit Remark'
      END AS "action_btn_disaplay_name"


FROM
(SELECT
feedback.id as id,
feedback.mentee_id AS mentee_id,
feedback.fdbk_date AS fdbk_date,
feedback.fdbk_remark AS fdbk_remark,
feedback.fdbk_hr_remark AS fdbk_hr_remark,

datatables_config.title: Report - Download
datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT DISTINCT dr.report_category AS "report_category", 
dr.report_type  AS "report_type", 
dr.file AS "report_file", 
MAX(dr.created) AS "created" 
FROM {daily_reports} AS dr
INNER JOIN
    (SELECT report_category, MAX(created) AS created, report_type 
FROM {daily_reports} 
    GROUP BY report_category, report_type) grouped_dr 
ON dr.created = grouped_dr.created 
WHERE dr.report_category IN (:report_category[] ) 
GROUP BY dr.report_category, dr.report_type, dr.file

     rdl.department AS "department", 
     rdl.sub_department AS "sub_department",

     CASE WHEN sum(report_task_summary.open_green) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('tracking-report?color=d_gr&sub_department=',rdl.sub_department) END AS "open_green_link",

     sum(report_task_summary.open_red) AS "open_red", 
     CASE WHEN sum(report_task_summary.open_green) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('tracking-report?color=b_re&sub_department=',rdl.sub_department) END AS "open_red_link", 
     sum(report_task_summary.open_black) AS "open_black", 
     CASE WHEN sum(report_task_summary.open_green) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('tracking-report?color=a_bl&sub_department=',rdl.sub_department) END AS "open_black_link", 
     sum(report_task_summary.open_green + report_task_summary.open_yellow + report_task_summary.open_red + report_task_summary.open_black) AS "open_total", 
     CASE WHEN sum(report_task_summary.open_green) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('tracking-report?color=&sub_department=',rdl.sub_department) END AS "open_total_link", 
     sum(report_task_summary.close_green) AS "close_green", 
     sum(report_task_summary.close_yellow) AS "close_yellow", 
     sum(report_task_summary.close_red) AS "close_red", 
     sum(report_task_summary.close_black) AS "close_black", 
     sum(report_task_summary.close_green + report_task_summary.close_yellow + report_task_summary.close_red + report_task_summary.close_black) AS "close_total", 
     sum(report_task_summary.open_green + report_task_summary.open_yellow + report_task_summary.open_red + report_task_summary.open_black + report_task_summary.close_green + report_task_summary.close_yellow + report_task_summary.close_red + report_task_summary.close_black) AS "open_close_total" 
     FROM {report_task_summary} AS report_task_summary
     LEFT JOIN {role_department_list} AS rdl ON rdl.role = report_task_summary.assigned_role 
     LEFT JOIN {workflow} AS wf ON report_task_summary.bo_type = wf.wf_code  
     WHERE report_task_summary.assigned_role <> 'master_scheduler' 
     GROUP BY 
          rdl.role, rdl.department, rdl.sub_department, report_task_summary.task_display_name, report_task_summary.unit order by report_task_summary.unit, rdl.department

datatables_config.title: Task Iterations
datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT t.task_id AS "task_id", bo.json_data->>'name' AS "name", bo.json_data->>'domain' AS "domain", addon.addon_fields_json->>'category' AS "addon_category" ,
addon.addon_fields_json->>'skill_code' AS "skill_code",
bo.json_data->>'email' AS "email", 
bo.json_data->>'stream' AS "stream", 
bo.json_data->>'team' AS "team", 
bo.json_data->>'team' AS "category", 
bo.json_data->>'goal_path' AS "goal_path", 
bo.json_data->>'employee_id' AS "employee_id", 
CONCAT('bo-details/', t.bo_id) AS "bo_id_link", 
t.bo_id AS "bo_id", 
bo.json_data->>'belt' AS "belt", t.task_display_name AS "task_name", t.tkt_code AS "task_code", t.assigned_on AS "task_assigned_on", t.closed_on AS "task_closed_date", t.status AS "task_status", 

CASE WHEN t.status = 'open'
THEN 
	CASE WHEN t.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid THEN 'not started'
	 WHEN t.sub_status = 'hold' THEN 'Hold'
	ELSE 'open'
	END
ELSE 'closed' END AS "task_status",

CASE
  WHEN t.status = 'closed' THEN
    CASE
      WHEN cth.task_hold_days IS NOT NULL THEN
        DATE_PART('day', to_timestamp(t.closed_on) - to_timestamp(t.assigned_on)) - cth.task_hold_days
      ELSE
        DATE_PART('day', to_timestamp(t.closed_on) - to_timestamp(t.assigned_on))
    END
  WHEN t.status = 'open' AND t.assigned_uid != 2 THEN
    CASE
      WHEN cth.task_hold_days IS NOT NULL THEN
        DATE_PART('day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(t.assigned_on)) - cth.task_hold_days
      ELSE
        DATE_PART('day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(t.assigned_on))
    END
  ELSE
    0
END AS elapsed_days,


sd.subtask_json->>'title' AS "subtask", sd.subtask_json->>'remark' AS "subtask_remark", sd.subtask_json->>'status' AS "subtask_status", sd.subtask_json->>'created' AS "subtask_created", sd.subtask_json->>'completed_on' AS "subtask_completed" FROM {task} t JOIN {business_object} bo ON t.bo_id = bo.bo_id JOIN {subtask_data} sd ON t.task_id = sd.task_id  LEFT JOIN {process} AS process ON t.pr_id = process.pr_id LEFT JOIN {wf_tkt_addon_fields} AS addon ON addon.wf_id = process.wf_id AND addon.task_name = t.task_name 
LEFT JOIN {view_calculated_task_hold_days} AS cth ON t.task_id = cth.task_id

tc.color AS "color",

bo.json_data->>'remarks' AS "remark", 
bo.json_data->>'category' AS "category", 
task.tkt_code AS "ticket_code",

datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT 
task.status AS "status", 
task.task_id AS "task_id", 
task.created AS "created_date", 
task.task_start_date AS "task_start_date", 
task.buffer_hrs AS "sla_hrs", 
bo.bo_color AS "bo_color", 
task.task_display_name AS "task_display_name", 
CONCAT('bo-details/', task.bo_id) AS "bo_id_link", 
task.bo_id AS "bo_id", 
task.next_followup AS "task_next_followup", 
bo.json_data->>'client' AS "client",  
bo.json_data->>'description_combo'  AS "description_combo", 
bo.json_data->>'wbs_combo'  AS "wbs_combo", 
bo.json_data->>'project_eng'  AS "project_engineer", 
bo.json_data->>'country_name' AS "country",  
bo.json_data->>'initiative_type' AS "initiative_type",  
SPLIT_PART(bo.bo_id, '-', 2) AS "initiative_id",
CASE 
     WHEN (CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'Followup Ticket'
     ELSE bo.json_data->>'category' 
    END AS "category_type", 
CASE 
     WHEN (CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= :time ) THEN  'ALL Current Ticket'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "all_category", 
user_full_name .field_full_name_value AS "assigned_user_name", 
task.tkt_code AS "ticket_code", 
role_department_list.sub_department AS "department", 
CASE WHEN task.close_button_on_list = '1' THEN 'Close' ELSE '' END AS "close_button_on_list" ,
CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed' 
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date)) 
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
ELSE NULL
END AS elapsed_days,
bo.json_data->>'category' AS "category", 
bo.json_data->>'brand_name' AS "brand", 
bo.json_data->>'pack_size' AS "pack_size", 
bo.json_data->>'act_approval_dt' AS "act_approval_dt", 
bo.json_data->>'commercial_status' AS "commercial_status", 
bo.json_data->>'lapse_time' AS "lapse_time", 
bo.json_data->>'validity' AS "validity",
bo.json_data->>'visa_no' AS "visa_no",
bo.json_data->>'due_date' AS "due_date" 
    FROM 
        {task} AS task 
    LEFT JOIN 
        {users_field_data} AS users ON task.created_by = users.uid 
    LEFT JOIN 
        {process} AS process ON task.pr_id = process.pr_id 
    LEFT JOIN 
        {business_object} AS bo ON task.bo_id = bo.bo_id 
    LEFT JOIN 
        {role_department_list} AS role_department_list ON task.sub_department = role_department_list.sub_department
    LEFT JOIN 
        {user__field_full_name} AS user_full_name ON task.assigned_uid = user_full_name.entity_id  
    WHERE 
         task.status = 'open' 
        AND bo.bo_status = 'active' 
        AND process.process_status <> 80 
        AND task.display_flag = 1 
        AND CAST(task.task_start_date AS INTEGER) <= CAST(:time AS INTEGER) 

UNION

    SELECT 
task.status AS "status", 
task.task_id AS "task_id", 
task.created AS "created_date", 
task.task_start_date AS "task_start_date", 
task.buffer_hrs AS "sla_hrs", 
bo.bo_color AS "bo_color", 
task.task_display_name AS "task_display_name", 
CONCAT('bo-details/', task.bo_id) AS "bo_id_link", 
task.bo_id AS "bo_id", 
task.next_followup AS "task_next_followup", 
bo.json_data->>'client' AS "client",  
bo.json_data->>'description_combo'  AS "description_combo", 
bo.json_data->>'wbs_combo'  AS "wbs_combo", 
bo.json_data->>'project_eng'  AS "project_engineer", 
bo.json_data->>'country_name' AS "country",  
bo.json_data->>'initiative_type' AS "initiative_type",  
SPLIT_PART(bo.bo_id, '-', 2) AS "initiative_id",
CASE 
     WHEN (CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'Followup Ticket'
     ELSE bo.json_data->>'category' 
    END AS "category_type", 
CASE 
     WHEN (CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= :time ) THEN  'ALL Current Ticket'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "all_category", 
user_full_name .field_full_name_value AS "assigned_user_name", 
task.tkt_code AS "ticket_code", 
role_department_list.sub_department AS "department", 
CASE WHEN task.close_button_on_list = '1' THEN 'Close' ELSE '' END AS "close_button_on_list" ,
CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed' 
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date)) 
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
ELSE NULL
END AS elapsed_days,
bo.json_data->>'category' AS "category", 
bo.json_data->>'brand_name' AS "brand", 
bo.json_data->>'pack_size' AS "pack_size", 
bo.json_data->>'act_approval_dt' AS "act_approval_dt", 
bo.json_data->>'commercial_status' AS "commercial_status", 
bo.json_data->>'lapse_time' AS "lapse_time", 
bo.json_data->>'validity' AS "validity",
bo.json_data->>'visa_no' AS "visa_no",
bo.json_data->>'due_date' AS "due_date" 
FROM 
        {task} AS task 
    LEFT JOIN 
        {users_field_data} AS users ON task.created_by = users.uid 
    LEFT JOIN 
        {process} AS process ON task.pr_id = process.pr_id 
    LEFT JOIN 
        {business_object} AS bo ON task.bo_id = bo.bo_id 
    LEFT JOIN 
        {role_department_list} AS role_department_list ON task.sub_department = role_department_list.sub_department
    LEFT JOIN 
        {user__field_full_name} AS user_full_name ON task.assigned_uid = user_full_name.entity_id  
    WHERE 
         task.status = 'closed' 
        AND DATE(TO_TIMESTAMP(task.closed_on)) = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'

datatables_config.title: User Queue Report
datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT 
        role_department_list.department AS "department", 
        role_department_list.sub_department AS "sub_department", 
        t.assigned_uid AS "assigned_uid", 
        CASE WHEN t.assigned_uid = 2 THEN 'Unassigned' ELSE u.name END AS "name", 
        CASE WHEN t.assigned_uid = 2 THEN '-' ELSE u.mail END AS "mail", 
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.color = 'a_bl' AND t.status = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "open_black", 
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.color = 'b_re' AND t.status = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "open_red", 
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.color = 'c_ye' AND t.status = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "open_yellow", 
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.color = 'd_gr' AND t.status = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "open_green", 
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.color = 'e_wh' AND t.status = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "no_color", 
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "total_tkts",  
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.color = 'a_bl' AND t.status = 'closed' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(to_timestamp(t.closed_on) as DATE)) = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE as DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "close_black",  
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.color = 'b_re' AND t.status = 'closed' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(to_timestamp(t.closed_on) as DATE)) = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE as DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "close_red",  
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.color = 'c_ye' AND t.status = 'closed' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(to_timestamp(t.closed_on) as DATE)) = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE as DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "close_yellow",  
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.color = 'd_gr' AND t.status = 'closed' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(to_timestamp(t.closed_on) as DATE)) = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE as DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "close_green", 
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.color = 'e_wh' AND t.status = 'closed' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(to_timestamp(t.closed_on) as DATE)) = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE as DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "close_no_color", 
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'closed' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(to_timestamp(t.closed_on) as DATE)) = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE as DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "closed_total_tkts", 
SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'closed' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(to_timestamp(t.closed_on) as DATE)) = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE as DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "open_closed_total_tkts"  
    FROM (
        (
            vf_task t 
            JOIN vf_task_color c 
            ON (t.task_id = c.task_id)
        ) 
        JOIN vf_users_field_data u 
        ON (t.assigned_uid = u.uid AND u.status = 1) 
JOIN vf_role_department_list AS role_department_list ON t.sub_department = role_department_list.sub_department 

    ) 
    WHERE t.task_start_date < EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE as DATE)) 
    AND t.display_flag = 1  AND  u.name != 'wcms_admin'

    GROUP BY role_department_list.department, role_department_list.sub_department, t.assigned_uid, u.name, u.mail 
    ORDER BY role_department_list.department, role_department_list.sub_department

SELECT 
    ct.bo_id as "initiative",
    bo.json_data->>'season' as "season",
    bo.json_data->>'program' as "program",
    bo.bo_color as "priority",
    bo.json_data->>'quality' as "quality",
    bo.json_data->>'color' as "json_color",
bo.business_unit AS "business_unit",

    CASE
WHEN process.process_status = 2 
THEN 'Closed'
WHEN process.process_status = 1 THEN 'Active'
ELSE NULL
END AS "status",
    CASE
      WHEN process.process_status = 2 
      THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(process.process_end_dt) - to_timestamp(process.process_start_dt)) 
       WHEN process.process_status = 1 AND CAST (process.process_start_dt as INTEGER) < :time
       THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(process.process_start_dt))
       ELSE NULL
    END AS "elapsed_days",
    ct.sw_3130_to_ct_3140 as "greige_for_inspection_rejected",
    ct.sw_3200_to_ct_ic3070 as "iic_testing_rejected",
    ct.sw_3220_to_ct_ic3070 as "qc_testing_lab_knitting_issue",
    ct.sw_3220_to_ct_ic3210 as "qc_testing_lab_finishing_issue",
    ct.sw_3230_to_ct_ic3070 as "lab_testing_knitting_issue",
    ct.sw_3230_to_ct_ic3210 as "lab_testing_finishing_issue",
    ct.sw_3240_to_ct_ic3070 as "qc_inspection_knitting_issue",
    ct.sw_3240_to_ct_ic3210 as "qc_inspection_finishing_issue",
    ct.sw_3200_to_ct_3140 as "sample_dyeing_rejected"

FROM 
    crosstab(
        $$SELECT ic.bo_id, pv_code, count 
         FROM vf_iteration_counts ic 
         ORDER BY ic.bo_id, pv_code$$,
         $$VALUES ('sw_3130_to_ct_3140'), ('sw_3200_to_ct_ic3070'), ('sw_3220_to_ct_ic3070'), ('sw_3220_to_ct_ic3210'),('sw_3230_to_ct_ic3070'), ('sw_3230_to_ct_ic3210'),('sw_3240_to_ct_ic3070'), ('sw_3240_to_ct_ic3210'), ('sw_3200_to_ct_3140')$$
        
    ) AS ct (
        bo_id int,
        sw_3130_to_ct_3140 float,
        sw_3200_to_ct_ic3070 float,
        sw_3220_to_ct_ic3070 float,
        sw_3220_to_ct_ic3210 float,
        sw_3230_to_ct_ic3070 float,
        sw_3230_to_ct_ic3210 float,
        sw_3240_to_ct_ic3070 float,
        sw_3240_to_ct_ic3210 float,
        sw_3200_to_ct_3140 float
    )
JOIN  {business_object} bo ON ct.bo_id = bo.bo_id  
LEFT JOIN {bo_wf_mapping} AS bo_wf_mapping ON bo.bo_id = bo_wf_mapping.bo_id 
LEFT JOIN {process} AS process ON bo_wf_mapping.id = process.bo_wf_mapping_id  
WHERE bo.bo_type = 'UQL_FH'
ORDER BY   process.process_status ASC , CASE WHEN bo_color IS NULL OR bo_color = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, bo_color ASC, buff_penetration_days DESC, due_date ASC, process.bo_wf_mapping_id DESC, process.updated DESC

datatables_config.title: Task Bo View
datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT 
task.task_id AS "task_id", 
task.tkt_code AS "ticket_code", 
task.task_display_name AS "ticket", 
role_department_list.department AS "team", 
users.field_full_name_value AS "assigned_to", 
users.entity_id AS "task_uid", 
CASE 
WHEN task.sub_status = 'not_started'  THEN 'Not Started'  
ELSE task.status 
END AS "status", 
CONCAT('ticket-details/', task.task_id) AS "link", 
task.task_start_date AS "start_date", 
task.closed_on AS "closed_on", 
task.assigned_on AS "assigned_on", 
task.display_flag AS "display_flag", 
bo.bo_color AS "bo_color", 
tc.color AS "color", 
task.pr_id AS "process_id" ,
task.reopen_count AS "reopen_count"
FROM {task} AS task 
LEFT JOIN {business_object} AS bo ON task.bo_id = bo.bo_id 
LEFT JOIN {task_color} AS tc ON task.task_id = tc.task_id 
LEFT JOIN {user__field_full_name} AS users ON task.assigned_uid = users.entity_id  
LEFT JOIN {role_department_list} AS role_department_list ON task.assigned_role= role_department_list.role  
WHERE task.bo_id = :bo_id AND bo.business_unit IN (:business_unit[] ) AND ( (task.task_name NOT LIKE 'se_end' ) AND (task.tkt_code NOT LIKE '%IC%' ) )  AND task.assigned_role != 'Master Scheduler'  ORDER BY task.status DESC, task.created DESC

        SUM(CASE WHEN bo.bo_color = 'e_wh' AND t.status = 'closed' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(to_timestamp(t.closed_on) as DATE)) = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE as DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "close_no_color", 
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'closed' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(to_timestamp(t.closed_on) as DATE)) = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE as DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "close_total", 
SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'closed' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(to_timestamp(t.closed_on) as DATE)) = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE as DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "open_close_total"  
    FROM (
        (
            vf_task t 
            JOIN vf_business_object  bo 
            ON (t.bo_id = bo.bo_id)
			
		LEFT JOIN vf_process as p  ON t.pr_id = p.pr_id
		LEFT JOIN vf_workflow as w ON w.wf_id = p.wf_id

        ) 
)	
where t.assigned_role <> 'master_scheduler' 

    GROUP BY  t.task_display_name, w.wf_name

datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT 
 CASE
 WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'Initiate & Assign'
      WHEN task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid THEN 'Assign'
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid THEN 'Reassign'
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER) THEN 'Awake'
      ELSE ''
      END AS "btn",
CASE
      WHEN task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid THEN CONCAT('assign')
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid THEN CONCAT('reassign')
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER) THEN CONCAT('awake')
      ELSE ''
      END AS link, 
task.created AS "created_date",  
CASE 
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid ) THEN  'Assigned to other'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'Future ticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :loggedIn_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'Followup ticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'Unassigned'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "category_type", 
CASE 
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid ) THEN  'otherticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'otherticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :loggedIn_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'otherticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'otherticket'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "all_otherticket", 
    fm.uri AS "custom_full_img", 
    fm.uri AS "custom_thumbnail_img", 
    '' AS "image_placeholder", 
    task.task_id AS "task_id", 
    bo.bo_color AS "color", 
    task.status AS "status", 
    task.task_display_name AS "task_display_name", 
    task.bo_id AS "bo_id", 
    task.assigned_uid AS "task_assigned_uid", 
    users.name AS "assigned_to", 
    task.tkt_code AS "task_tkt_code", 
    users.name AS "assigned_to", 
    task.next_followup AS "task_next_followup", 
    task.task_start_date AS "task_start_date", 
    task.buffer_hrs AS "sla_hrs", 
    tc.elapsed_time AS "elapsed_hrs", 
    role_department_list.department AS "department", 
    role_department_list.sub_department AS "sub_department", 

CASE WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND (CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER))) THEN bo.json_data->>'category' ELSE NULL END AS "category" ,


bo.json_data->>'brand_name' AS "brand", 

bo.json_data->>'pack_size' AS "pack_size", 

bo.json_data->>'act_approval_dt' AS "act_approval_dt", 

bo.json_data->>'commercial_status' AS "commercial_status", 

bo.json_data->>'lapse_time' AS "lapse_time", 

bo.json_data->>'validity' AS "validity", 
CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed' 
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date)) 
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))

ELSE NULL
END AS elapsed_days,
bo.json_data->>'country_name' AS "country",  
bo.json_data->>'initiative_type' AS "initiative_type",  
user_full_name .field_full_name_value AS "assigned_user_name",
bo.json_data->>'visa_no' AS "visa_no",
SPLIT_PART(bo.bo_id, '-', 2) AS "initiative_id",
bo.json_data->>'due_date' AS "due_date"
FROM {task} as task 

LEFT JOIN {task_color} as tc ON task.task_id = tc.task_id 
LEFT JOIN {users_field_data} as users ON task.assigned_uid = users.uid 
LEFT JOIN {process} as process ON task.pr_id = process.pr_id 
LEFT JOIN {business_object} as bo ON task.bo_id = bo.bo_id 
LEFT JOIN {file_managed} fm ON bo.bo_img_fid = fm.fid 
LEFT JOIN {role_department_list} as role_department_list ON task.sub_department = role_department_list.sub_department 
LEFT JOIN {user__field_full_name} AS user_full_name ON task.assigned_uid = user_full_name .entity_id 
WHERE task.status = 'open' AND role_department_list.role IN (:user_roles[] )    AND  process.process_status <> 80 AND task.display_flag = 1  AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(to_timestamp(task.task_start_date) AS DATE))<=EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE AS DATE)) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid 
ORDER BY color ASC, due_date ASC, task_id ASC

datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT 
fm.uri AS "custom_full_img", 
fm.uri AS "custom_thumbnail_img", 
'' AS "image_placeholder", 

CASE
      WHEN CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > :time THEN 'Not Started'
       WHEN task.status = 'open' THEN 'Open'
      WHEN task.status = 'closed' THEN 'Closed'
ELSE ''
      END AS "status",

CASE
    WHEN task.status = 'closed' THEN 'true'
    ELSE 'false'
END AS "is_disabled",

task.task_id AS "task_id", 
CONCAT('ticket-details/', task.task_id,'?destination=/all-tasks') as "task_id_link",
CONCAT('ticket-details/', task.task_id)  as "view_task",



task.created AS "created_date", 
CASE
      WHEN CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > :time THEN NULL
      ELSE task.task_start_date
      END AS "task_start_date",
task.buffer_hrs AS "sla_hrs", 
tc.elapsed_time AS "elapsed_hrs", 
tc.color AS "priority",
tc.color AS "color",
bo.bo_color AS "bo_color", 
bo.business_unit AS "business_unit",
bo.client_due_date AS "client_due_date",
task.task_display_name AS "task_display_name", 
task.closed_on AS "task_closed_dt",  
CONCAT('ticket-details/', task.task_id,'?destination=/all-tasks') AS "task_code_link", 
CONCAT('bo-details/', task.bo_id) AS "bo_id_link", 
task.bo_id AS "bo_id", 
task.closed_on AS "closed_on",
task.next_followup AS "task_next_followup", 
bo.bo_id  AS "initiative_id",

bo.json_data->>'season'  AS "season",
bo.json_data->>'program' AS "program",
bo.json_data->>'fabrication' AS "fabrication",
bo.json_data->>'design_details' AS "design_details",
bo.json_data->>'yarn_details' AS "yarn_details",
bo.json_data->>'composition' AS "composition",
bo.json_data->>'knitting' AS "knitting",
bo.json_data->>'finishing_details' AS "finishing_details",
bo.json_data->>'trim_details' AS "trim_details",
bo.json_data->>'loop_length' AS "loop_length",
bo.json_data->>'request_receipt_date' AS "request_receipt_date",
bo.json_data->>'customer_required_date' AS "customer_required_date",
bo.json_data->>'pi_date' AS "pi_date",
bo.json_data->>'stage' AS "stage",
bo.json_data->>'internal_or_confirmed'  AS "internal_or_confirmed",
bo.json_data->>'color' AS "data_color",
bo.json_data->>'brandix_t_a' AS "brandix_t_a",
bo.json_data->>'csbd_date' AS "csbd_date",
bo.json_data->>'quality'  AS "quality",
bo.json_data->>'batch_no'  AS "batch_no",
bo.json_data->>'item_code'  AS "item_code",


bo.json_data->>'buyer'  AS "buyer",
bo.json_data->>'mcode_won_number'  AS "mcode_won_number",
bo.json_data->>'ex_mill_date'  AS "ex_mill_date",
bo.json_data->>'garment_desc'  AS "garment_desc",
bo.json_data->>'matching_instruction'  AS "matching_instruction",
bo.json_data->>'fabric_description'  AS "fabric_description",
bo.json_data->>'dye_part'  AS "dye_part",
bo.json_data->>'shade'  AS "shade",



CASE when (CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed'
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
ELSE NULL
END) > task.buffer_hrs THEN CONCAT('a_bl', ':', 'Delayed') ELSE NULL end as "delayed_status",



CASE 
     WHEN (CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'Followup Ticket'
     ELSE bo.json_data->>'category' 
    END AS "category_type", 
CASE 
     WHEN (CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= :time ) THEN  'ALL Current Ticket'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "all_category", 
user_full_name .field_full_name_value AS "assigned_user_name", 
task.tkt_code AS "task_code", 
role_department_list.sub_department AS "department", 
CASE WHEN task.close_button_on_list = '1' THEN 'Close' ELSE '' END AS "close_button_on_list" ,
CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed' 
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date)) 
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
ELSE NULL
END AS elapsed_days,
bo.json_data->>'category' AS "category", 
bo.json_data->>'due_date' AS "due_date",

EXTRACT(epoch FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(bo.json_data->>'request_receipt_date', 'DD-Mon-YY')) as timestamp_req,
EXTRACT(epoch FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(bo.json_data->>'customer_required_date', 'DD-Mon-YY')) as timestamp_cust_req,
w.wf_code AS wf_code,
bo.business_unit AS "business_unit",
w.version AS "wf_version",
w.wf_id AS "wf_id"

FROM {task} AS task 
LEFT JOIN {task_entity_data} AS ted ON task.task_id = ted.task_id

LEFT JOIN {task_color} AS tc ON task.task_id = tc.task_id 
LEFT JOIN {users_field_data} AS users ON task.created_by = users.uid 
LEFT JOIN {process} AS process ON task.pr_id = process.pr_id 
LEFT JOIN {business_object} AS bo ON task.bo_id = bo.bo_id

ORDER BY  CASE WHEN bo_color IS NULL OR bo_color  =  '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, bo_color , buff_penetration_days DESC, bo.client_due_date ASC, elapsed_days DESC

datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT 
 CASE
      WHEN task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid THEN 'Unassigned'
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid OR task.assigned_uid = :loggedIn_uid THEN 'Assigned'
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER) THEN 'Awake'
      ELSE ''
      END AS "btn",
CASE
      WHEN task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid THEN CONCAT('assign')
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid OR task.assigned_uid = :loggedIn_uid THEN CONCAT('reassign')
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER) THEN CONCAT('awake')
      ELSE ''
      END AS link, 
task.created AS "created_date",  
CASE 
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid ) THEN  'Assigned to other'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'Future ticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :loggedIn_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'Followup ticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'Unassigned'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "category_type", 
CASE 
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid ) THEN  'unassignedticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'unassignedticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :loggedIn_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'unassignedticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'unassignedticket'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "all_unassignedticket", 
    fm.uri AS "custom_full_img", 
    fm.uri AS "custom_thumbnail_img", 
    '' AS "image_placeholder", 
    task.task_id AS "task_id", 
    bo.bo_color AS "color", 
    task.status AS "status", 
    task.task_display_name AS "task_display_name", 
    task.bo_id AS "bo_id", 
    task.assigned_uid AS "task_assigned_uid", 
    users.name AS "assigned_to", 
    task.tkt_code AS "task_tkt_code", 
    users.name AS "assigned_to", 
    task.next_followup AS "task_next_followup", 
    task.task_start_date AS "task_start_date", 
    task.buffer_hrs AS "sla_hrs", 
    tc.elapsed_time AS "elapsed_hrs", 
    role_department_list.department AS "department", 
    role_department_list.sub_department AS "sub_department", 

CASE WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND (CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER))) THEN bo.json_data->>'category' ELSE NULL END AS "category" ,


bo.json_data->>'brand_name' AS "brand", 

bo.json_data->>'pack_size' AS "pack_size", 

bo.json_data->>'act_approval_dt' AS "act_approval_dt", 

bo.json_data->>'commercial_status' AS "commercial_status", 

bo.json_data->>'lapse_time' AS "lapse_time", 

bo.json_data->>'validity' AS "validity", 
CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed' 
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date)) 
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))

ELSE NULL
END AS elapsed_days,
bo.json_data->>'country_name' AS "country",  
bo.json_data->>'initiative_type' AS "initiative_type",  
user_full_name .field_full_name_value AS "assigned_user_name",
bo.json_data->>'visa_no' AS "visa_no",
SPLIT_PART(bo.bo_id, '-', 2) AS "initiative_id",
bo.json_data->>'due_date' AS "due_date"
FROM {task} as task 

LEFT JOIN {task_color} as tc ON task.task_id = tc.task_id 
LEFT JOIN {users_field_data} as users ON task.assigned_uid = users.uid 
LEFT JOIN {process} as process ON task.pr_id = process.pr_id 
LEFT JOIN {business_object} as bo ON task.bo_id = bo.bo_id 
LEFT JOIN {file_managed} fm ON bo.bo_img_fid = fm.fid 
LEFT JOIN {role_department_list} as role_department_list ON task.sub_department = role_department_list.sub_department 
LEFT JOIN {user__field_full_name} AS user_full_name ON task.assigned_uid = user_full_name .entity_id 
WHERE task.status = 'open' AND role_department_list.role IN (:user_roles[] )    AND  process.process_status <> 80 AND task.display_flag = 1  AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(to_timestamp(task.task_start_date) AS DATE))<=EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE AS DATE)) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER)
ORDER BY color ASC, due_date ASC, task_id ASC

datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT 
 CASE
      WHEN task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid THEN 'Add to My Task'
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid THEN 'Reassign'
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER) THEN 'Awake'
      ELSE ''
      END AS "btn",
CASE
      WHEN task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid THEN CONCAT('assignSelf')
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid THEN CONCAT('reassign')
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER) THEN CONCAT('awake')
      ELSE ''
      END AS link, 
task.created AS "created_date",  
CASE 
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid ) THEN  'Assigned to other'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'Future ticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :loggedIn_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'Followup ticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'Unassigned'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "category_type", 
CASE 
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid ) THEN  'otherticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'otherticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :loggedIn_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'otherticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'otherticket'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "all_otherticket", 
    fm.uri AS "custom_full_img", 
    fm.uri AS "custom_thumbnail_img", 
    '' AS "image_placeholder", 
    task.task_id AS "task_id", 
    bo.bo_color AS "color", 
    task.status AS "status", 
    task.task_display_name AS "task_display_name", 
    task.bo_id AS "bo_id", 
    task.assigned_uid AS "task_assigned_uid", 
    users.name AS "assigned_to", 
    task.tkt_code AS "task_tkt_code", 
    users.name AS "assigned_to", 
    task.next_followup AS "task_next_followup", 
    task.task_start_date AS "task_start_date", 
    task.buffer_hrs AS "sla_hrs", 
    tc.elapsed_time AS "elapsed_hrs", 
    role_department_list.department AS "department", 
    role_department_list.sub_department AS "sub_department", 

CASE WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND (CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER))) THEN bo.json_data->>'category' ELSE NULL END AS "category" ,


bo.json_data->>'brand_name' AS "brand", 

bo.json_data->>'pack_size' AS "pack_size", 

bo.json_data->>'act_approval_dt' AS "act_approval_dt", 

bo.json_data->>'commercial_status' AS "commercial_status", 

bo.json_data->>'lapse_time' AS "lapse_time", 

bo.json_data->>'validity' AS "validity", 
CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed' 
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date)) 
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))

ELSE NULL
END AS elapsed_days,
bo.json_data->>'country_name' AS "country",  
bo.json_data->>'initiative_type' AS "initiative_type",  
user_full_name .field_full_name_value AS "assigned_user_name",
bo.json_data->>'visa_no' AS "visa_no",
SPLIT_PART(bo.bo_id, '-', 2) AS "initiative_id",
bo.json_data->>'due_date' AS "due_date"
FROM {task} as task 

LEFT JOIN {task_color} as tc ON task.task_id = tc.task_id 
LEFT JOIN {users_field_data} as users ON task.assigned_uid = users.uid 
LEFT JOIN {process} as process ON task.pr_id = process.pr_id 
LEFT JOIN {business_object} as bo ON task.bo_id = bo.bo_id 
LEFT JOIN {file_managed} fm ON bo.bo_img_fid = fm.fid 
LEFT JOIN {role_department_list} as role_department_list ON task.sub_department = role_department_list.sub_department 
LEFT JOIN {user__field_full_name} AS user_full_name ON task.assigned_uid = user_full_name .entity_id 
WHERE task.status = 'open'   AND  process.process_status <> 80 AND task.display_flag = 1  AND task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid  
ORDER BY color ASC, due_date ASC, task_id ASC

datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT 
'Show Errors' AS "btn", 
CASE WHEN field_error.field_error_value = '0' THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('input-file-errors?nid=',node_field_data.nid) END AS "link", node_field_data.created AS "date", 
node_field_data.title AS "fileid", 
node_field_data.nid AS "nid", 
fm.filename AS "filename", 
fm.uri AS "custom_uri1", 
field_verify.field_verified_value AS "verified_records", 
field_error.field_error_value AS "error_records" 
FROM {node_field_data} node_field_data 
JOIN {node__field_input_file} input_file ON node_field_data.nid = input_file.entity_id 
JOIN {node__field_tag} tag ON tag.entity_id = node_field_data.nid 
JOIN {file_managed} fm ON input_file.field_input_file_target_id = fm.fid 
LEFT JOIN {node__field_verified} field_verify ON node_field_data.nid = field_verify.entity_id 
LEFT JOIN {node__field_error} field_error ON node_field_data.nid = field_error.entity_id 
WHERE (node_field_data.type IN ('input_file_upload'))  AND  tag.field_tag_value  = 'TASK_REMAINING_DURATION_MASTER' AND
 tag.bundle = 'input_file_upload' and tag.field_tag_value != '1'  AND  node_field_data.uid = :loggedIn_uid  
ORDER BY node_field_data.created desc

    bo.json_data->>'program' as "program",
    bo.bo_color as "priority",
    bo.json_data->>'quality' as "quality",

bo.business_unit AS "business_unit",
    CASE
WHEN process.process_status = 2 
THEN 'Closed'
WHEN process.process_status = 1 THEN 'Active'
ELSE NULL
END as "status",
    CASE
      WHEN process.process_status = 2 
      THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(process.process_end_dt) - to_timestamp(process.process_start_dt)) 
       WHEN process.process_status = 1 AND CAST (process.process_start_dt as INTEGER) < :time
       THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(process.process_start_dt))
       ELSE NULL
    END AS "elapsed_days",
    ct.ct_1310_to_ct_1260 as "receipe_iteration_both_part",

SELECT 
fm.uri AS "custom_full_img", 
fm.uri AS "custom_thumbnail_img", 
'' AS "image_placeholder", 

CASE
      WHEN CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > :time THEN 'Not Started'
       WHEN task.status = 'open' THEN 'Open'
      WHEN task.status = 'closed' THEN 'Closed'
ELSE ''
      END AS "status",

CASE
    WHEN task.status = 'closed' THEN 'true'
    ELSE 'false'
END AS "is_disabled",

task.task_id AS "task_id", 
CONCAT('ticket-details/', task.task_id,'?destination=/all-tasks') as "task_id_link",
CONCAT('ticket-details/', task.task_id)  as "view_task",



task.created AS "created_date", 
CASE
      WHEN CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > :time THEN NULL
      ELSE task.task_start_date
      END AS "task_start_date",
task.buffer_hrs AS "sla_hrs", 
tc.elapsed_time AS "elapsed_hrs", 
tc.color AS "priority",
tc.color AS "color",
bo.bo_color AS "bo_color", 
bo.business_unit AS "business_unit",
bo.client_due_date AS "client_due_date",
task.task_display_name AS "task_display_name", 
task.closed_on AS "task_closed_dt",  
CONCAT('ticket-details/', task.task_id,'?destination=/all-tasks') AS "task_code_link", 
CONCAT('bo-details/', task.bo_id) AS "bo_id_link", 
task.bo_id AS "bo_id", 
task.next_followup AS "task_next_followup",

bo.json_data->>'fabrication' AS "fabrication",

bo.json_data->>'trim_details' AS "trim_details",
bo.json_data->>'loop_length' AS "loop_length",
bo.json_data->>'request_receipt_date' AS "request_receipt_date",
bo.json_data->>'customer_required_date' AS "customer_required_date",
bo.json_data->>'stage' AS "stage",
bo.json_data->>'color' AS "data_color",
bo.json_data->>'brandix_t_a' AS "brandix_t_a",
bo.json_data->>'csbd_date' AS "csbd_date",
bo.json_data->>'quality'  AS "quality",
bo.json_data->>'batch_no'  AS "batch_no",
bo.json_data->>'item_code'  AS "item_code",


bo.json_data->>'buyer'  AS "buyer",
bo.json_data->>'mcode_won_number'  AS "mcode_won_number",
bo.json_data->>'ex_mill_date'  AS "ex_mill_date",
bo.json_data->>'garment_desc'  AS "garment_desc",
bo.json_data->>'matching_instruction'  AS "matching_instruction",
bo.json_data->>'fabric_description'  AS "fabric_description",
bo.json_data->>'dye_part'  AS "dye_part",
bo.json_data->>'shade'  AS "shade",



CASE when (CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed'
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
ELSE NULL
END) > task.buffer_hrs THEN CONCAT('a_bl', ':', 'Delayed') ELSE NULL end as "delayed_status",



CASE 
     WHEN (CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'Followup Ticket'
     ELSE bo.json_data->>'category' 
    END AS "category_type", 
CASE 
     WHEN (CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= :time ) THEN  'ALL Current Ticket'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "all_category", 
user_full_name .field_full_name_value AS "assigned_user_name", 
task.tkt_code AS "ticket_code", 
role_department_list.sub_department AS "department", 
CASE WHEN task.close_button_on_list = '1' THEN 'Close' ELSE '' END AS "close_button_on_list" ,
CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed' 
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date)) 
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
ELSE NULL
END AS elapsed_days,
bo.json_data->>'category' AS "category", 
bo.json_data->>'due_date' AS "due_date",

ted.entity_data->>'remark' AS "all_task_remark",

EXTRACT(epoch FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(bo.json_data->>'request_receipt_date', 'DD-Mon-YY')) as timestamp_req,
EXTRACT(epoch FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(bo.json_data->>'customer_required_date', 'DD-Mon-YY')) as timestamp_cust_req


FROM {task} AS task 
LEFT JOIN {task_entity_data} AS ted ON task.task_id = ted.task_id

LEFT JOIN {task_color} AS tc ON task.task_id = tc.task_id 
LEFT JOIN {users_field_data} AS users ON task.created_by = users.uid 
LEFT JOIN {process} AS process ON task.pr_id = process.pr_id 
LEFT JOIN {business_object} AS bo ON task.bo_id = bo.bo_id 
LEFT JOIN {file_managed} fm ON bo.bo_img_fid = fm.fid 
LEFT JOIN {role_department_list} AS role_department_list ON task.sub_department= role_department_list.sub_department
LEFT JOIN {user__field_full_name} AS user_full_name ON task.assigned_uid = user_full_name .entity_id 
WHERE ((:bo_id IS NULL) OR (bo.bo_id = :bo_id )) AND ((:status IS NULL) OR (task.status = lower(:status) )) AND  ((:start_date IS NULL AND :end_date IS NULL) OR (task.task_start_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date )) AND task.assigned_role != 'Master Scheduler' AND task.display_flag = 1 
ORDER BY  task.status DESC,  CASE WHEN color IS NULL OR color  =  '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, color,due_date ASC

datatables_config.title: Department Tasks Trend
datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT 
     report_task_summary.dt AS "date",
     rdl.role AS "role", 
     rdl.department AS "department", 
     rdl.sub_department AS "sub_department", 
     sum(report_task_summary.open_green) AS "open_green", 
     CASE WHEN sum(report_task_summary.open_green) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('tracking-report?color=d_gr&sub_department=',rdl.sub_department) END AS "open_green_link", 
     sum(report_task_summary.open_yellow) AS "open_yellow", 
     CASE WHEN sum(report_task_summary.open_yellow) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('tracking-report?color=c_ye&sub_department=',rdl.sub_department) END AS "open_yellow_link", 
     sum(report_task_summary.open_red) AS "open_red", 
     CASE WHEN sum(report_task_summary.open_red) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('tracking-report?color=b_re&sub_department=',rdl.sub_department) END AS "open_red_link", 
     sum(report_task_summary.open_black) AS "open_black", 
     CASE WHEN sum(report_task_summary.open_black) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('tracking-report?color=a_bl&sub_department=',rdl.sub_department) END AS "open_black_link", 
     sum(report_task_summary.open_green + report_task_summary.open_yellow + report_task_summary.open_red + report_task_summary.open_black) AS "open_total", 
     CASE WHEN sum(report_task_summary.open_green + report_task_summary.open_yellow + report_task_summary.open_red + report_task_summary.open_black) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('tracking-report?color=&sub_department=',rdl.sub_department) END AS "open_total_link", 
     sum(report_task_summary.close_green) AS "close_green", 
     sum(report_task_summary.close_yellow) AS "close_yellow", 
     sum(report_task_summary.close_red) AS "close_red", 
     sum(report_task_summary.close_black) AS "close_black", 
     report_task_summary.field_1 AS "field1",
     report_task_summary.field_2 AS "field2",
     sum(report_task_summary.close_green + report_task_summary.close_yellow + report_task_summary.close_red + report_task_summary.close_black) AS "close_total", 
     sum(report_task_summary.open_green + report_task_summary.open_yellow + report_task_summary.open_red + report_task_summary.open_black + report_task_summary.close_green + report_task_summary.close_yellow + report_task_summary.close_red + report_task_summary.close_black) AS "open_close_total" ,
report_task_summary.unit AS "business_unit"

     FROM {report_task_summary} AS report_task_summary
     JOIN {role_department_list} AS rdl ON rdl.role = report_task_summary.assigned_role 
     LEFT JOIN {workflow} AS wf ON wf.wf_code = report_task_summary.bo_type 
WHERE report_task_summary.report_type IS NULL  AND wf.status = 'active' 
AND CASE WHEN :start_date IS NOT NULL AND :end_date IS NOT NULL THEN (dt BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date ) 
ELSE (dt BETWEEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE - 10 as DATE)) AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE as DATE))) END   
AND  (open_black + open_red +  open_yellow + open_green + close_black + close_red  + close_yellow + close_green) <> 0  
GROUP BY 
          report_task_summary.dt,rdl.role, rdl.department, rdl.sub_department , report_task_summary.field_1, report_task_summary.field_2, report_task_summary.unit 
ORDER BY report_task_summary.dt DESC

SELECT

    bo.bo_color as "priority",
    bo.json_data->>'quality' as "quality",

bo.business_unit AS "business_unit",

    CASE WHEN process.process_status = 2 
THEN 'Closed'
WHEN process.process_status = 1 THEN 'Active'
ELSE NULL
END AS "status",
    CASE
      WHEN process.process_status = 2 
      THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(process.process_end_dt) - to_timestamp(process.process_start_dt)) 
       WHEN process.process_status = 1 AND CAST (process.process_start_dt as INTEGER) < :time
       THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(process.process_start_dt))
       ELSE NULL
    END AS "elapsed_days",
    ct.sw_3070_to_ct_3470 as "dyeing_and_color_matching_rejected",

datatables_config.title: User Tasks Trend
datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT report_task_summary.dt AS "date", 
role_department_list.sub_department AS "department", 
users.field_full_name_value AS "username", users.entity_id AS "uid", 
SUM(report_task_summary.open_black) AS "open_black", 
SUM(report_task_summary.open_red) AS "open_red", 
SUM(report_task_summary.open_yellow) AS "open_yellow", 
SUM(report_task_summary.open_green) AS "open_green", 
SUM((open_black) + (open_red)  + (open_yellow) + (open_green)) AS "open_total", 
SUM(report_task_summary.close_black) AS "close_black", 
SUM(report_task_summary.close_green) AS "close_green", 
SUM(report_task_summary.close_red) AS "close_red", 
SUM(report_task_summary.close_yellow) AS "close_yellow", 
report_task_summary.field_1 AS "field1",
report_task_summary.field_2 AS "field2",
SUM((close_black) + (close_red) + (close_yellow) + (close_green)) AS "close_total", 
SUM((open_black) + (open_red) +  (open_yellow) + (open_green) + (close_black) + (close_red)  + (close_yellow) + (close_green)) AS "todays_total" ,
report_task_summary.unit AS "business_unit"

FROM 
{report_task_summary} report_task_summary 
JOIN {user__field_full_name} users ON report_task_summary.assigned_uid = users.entity_id 
JOIN {role_department_list} role_department_list ON report_task_summary.assigned_role = role_department_list.role  
JOIN {workflow} wf ON report_task_summary.bo_type = wf.wf_code  
WHERE   report_task_summary.report_type IS NULL AND  wf.status = 'active' AND report_task_summary.name != 'wcms_admin'  
AND (open_black + open_red +  open_yellow + open_green + close_black + close_red  + close_yellow + close_green) <> 0  
AND CASE WHEN :start_date IS NOT NULL AND :end_date IS NOT NULL THEN (dt BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date ) 
ELSE (dt BETWEEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE - 10 as DATE)) AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE as DATE))) END  
GROUP BY report_task_summary.dt, role_department_list.sub_department, users.field_full_name_value, users.entity_id, report_task_summary.field_1,report_task_summary.field_2 , report_task_summary.unit
ORDER BY report_task_summary.dt DESC

datatables_config.title: File Upload Status
datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT 
'Show Errors' AS "btn", 
CASE WHEN field_error.field_error_value = '0' THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('input-file-errors?nid=',node_field_data.nid,'&tag=',tag.field_tag_value) END AS "link", node_field_data.created AS "date", 
node_field_data.title AS "fileid", 
node_field_data.nid AS "nid", 
fm.filename AS "filename", 
fm.uri AS "custom_uri1", 
field_verify.field_verified_value AS "verified_records", 
field_error.field_error_value AS "error_records" 
FROM {node_field_data} node_field_data 
JOIN {node__field_input_file} input_file ON node_field_data.nid = input_file.entity_id 
JOIN {node__field_tag} tag ON tag.entity_id = node_field_data.nid 
JOIN {file_managed} fm ON input_file.field_input_file_target_id = fm.fid 
LEFT JOIN {node__field_verified} field_verify ON node_field_data.nid = field_verify.entity_id 
LEFT JOIN {node__field_error} field_error ON node_field_data.nid = field_error.entity_id 
WHERE (node_field_data.type IN ('input_file_upload'))  AND 
 tag.bundle = 'input_file_upload' and tag.field_tag_value != '1'  AND node_field_data.title LIKE '%DF-API%' AND node_field_data.uid = :loggedIn_uid  
ORDER BY node_field_data.created desc

datatables_config.title: Initiative Trend
datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT report_task_summary.dt AS "date", 
SUM(report_task_summary.open_black) AS "open_black", 
SUM(report_task_summary.open_red) AS "open_red", 
SUM(report_task_summary.open_yellow) AS "open_yellow", 
SUM(report_task_summary.open_green) AS "open_green", 
SUM(COALESCE(open_black,0) + COALESCE(open_red,0)  + COALESCE(open_yellow,0) + COALESCE(open_green,0)) AS "open_total", 
SUM(report_task_summary.close_black) AS "close_black", 
SUM(report_task_summary.close_green) AS "close_green", 
SUM(report_task_summary.close_red) AS "close_red", 
SUM(report_task_summary.close_yellow) AS "close_yellow", 
SUM(COALESCE(close_black,0) + COALESCE(close_red,0) + COALESCE(close_yellow,0) + COALESCE(close_green,0)) AS "close_total", 
SUM(COALESCE(open_black,0) + COALESCE(open_red,0) +  COALESCE(open_yellow,0) + COALESCE(open_green,0) + COALESCE(close_black,0) + COALESCE(close_red,0)  + COALESCE(close_yellow,0) + COALESCE(close_green,0)) AS "todays_total" ,
report_task_summary.field_1 AS "field1",
report_task_summary.field_2 AS "field2",
report_task_summary.bo_type AS "wf_code", 
wf.wf_name AS "initiative_type" ,
report_task_summary.unit AS business_unit

FROM 
{report_task_summary} report_task_summary 
JOIN {workflow} wf ON report_task_summary.bo_type = wf.wf_code  
where report_type = 'initiative'  AND wf.status = 'active' 
AND CASE WHEN :start_date IS NOT NULL AND :end_date IS NOT NULL THEN (dt BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date ) 
ELSE (dt BETWEEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE - 10 as DATE)) AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE as DATE))) END  
AND (open_black + open_red  + open_yellow + open_green) <> 0 
GROUP BY 
    report_task_summary.dt, report_task_summary.bo_type,  wf.wf_name , report_task_summary.field_1,report_task_summary.field_2  , report_task_summary.unit

ORDER BY report_task_summary.dt DESC

SELECT 
 CASE
      WHEN task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid THEN 'Add to My Task'
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid THEN 'Reassign'
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER) THEN 'Awake'
      ELSE ''
      END AS "action_button",
CASE
      WHEN task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid THEN CONCAT('assignSelf')
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid THEN CONCAT('reassign')
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER) THEN CONCAT('awake')
      ELSE ''
      END AS link, 
task.created AS "created_date",  
CASE 
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid ) THEN  'Assigned to other'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'Future ticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :loggedIn_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'Followup ticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'Unassigned'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "category_type", 
CASE 
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid ) THEN  'otherticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'otherticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :loggedIn_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'otherticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'otherticket'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "all_otherticket", 
    fm.uri AS "custom_full_img", 
    fm.uri AS "custom_thumbnail_img", 
    '' AS "image_placeholder", 
    task.task_id AS "task_id", 
    tc.color AS "color",
tc.color AS "priority",
    bo.bo_color AS "bo_color",  
    bo.business_unit AS "business_unit",
    bo.client_due_date AS "client_due_date",
    task.status AS "status", 
    task.task_display_name AS "task_display_name", 
    task.bo_id AS "bo_id", 
    task.assigned_uid AS "task_assigned_uid", 
    users.name AS "assigned_to", 
    task.tkt_code AS "task_tkt_code", 
    users.name AS "assigned_to", 
    task.next_followup AS "task_next_followup", 
    task.task_start_date AS "task_start_date", 
    task.buffer_hrs AS "sla_hrs", 
    tc.elapsed_time AS "elapsed_hrs", 
    role_department_list.department AS "department", 
    role_department_list.sub_department AS "sub_department", 
    bo.json_data->>'category' AS "category",  
    bo.json_data->>'batch_no'  AS "batch_no",
    bo.json_data->>'item_code'  AS "item_code",
  
CASE WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND (CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER))) THEN bo.json_data->>'category' ELSE NULL END AS "category" ,

bo.json_data->>'season'  AS "season",
bo.json_data->>'program' AS "program",
bo.json_data->>'fabrication' AS "fabrication",

bo.json_data->>'dye_part'  AS "dye_part",

bo.json_data->>'internal_or_confirmed'  AS "internal_or_confirmed",

CASE when (CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed'
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
ELSE NULL
END) > task.buffer_hrs THEN CONCAT('a_bl', ':', 'Delayed') ELSE NULL end as "delayed_status",


CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed' 
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date)) 
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))

ELSE NULL
END AS elapsed_days,
user_full_name .field_full_name_value AS "assigned_user_name",

bo.json_data->>'due_date' AS "due_date",
EXTRACT(epoch FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(bo.json_data->>'request_receipt_date', 'DD-Mon-YY')) as timestamp_req,
EXTRACT(epoch FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(bo.json_data->>'customer_required_date', 'DD-Mon-YY')) as timestamp_cust_req


FROM {task} as task 

LEFT JOIN {task_color} as tc ON task.task_id = tc.task_id 
LEFT JOIN {users_field_data} as users ON task.assigned_uid = users.uid 
LEFT JOIN {process} as process ON task.pr_id = process.pr_id 
LEFT JOIN {business_object} as bo ON task.bo_id = bo.bo_id 
LEFT JOIN {file_managed} fm ON bo.bo_img_fid = fm.fid 
LEFT JOIN {role_department_list} as role_department_list ON task.sub_department= role_department_list.sub_department 
LEFT JOIN {user__field_full_name} AS user_full_name ON task.assigned_uid = user_full_name .entity_id 


WHERE task.status = 'open'  AND role_department_list.role IN (:user_roles[] )  AND   process.process_status <> 80 AND task.display_flag = 1  AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(to_timestamp(task.task_start_date) AS DATE))<=EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CAST(CURRENT_DATE AS DATE)) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid  
AND bo.business_unit IN (:business_unit[] ) 

ORDER BY CASE WHEN bo_color IS NULL OR  bo_color  =  '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, bo_color, buff_penetration_days DESC, bo.client_due_date ASC, task_id ASC

SELECT 


 CASE
      WHEN task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid THEN 'Add to My Task'
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid THEN 'Reassign'
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER) THEN 'Awake'
      ELSE ''
      END AS "action_button",
CASE
      WHEN task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid THEN CONCAT('initiate_with_assign_self')
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid THEN CONCAT('reassign')
      WHEN task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER) THEN CONCAT('awake')
      ELSE ''
      END AS link, 
task.created AS "created_date",  
CASE 
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid ) THEN  'Assigned to other'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'Future ticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :loggedIn_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'Followup ticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'Unassigned'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "category_type", 
CASE 
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND task.assigned_uid != :loggedIn_uid ) THEN  'otherticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'otherticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :loggedIn_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'otherticket'
     WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER)) THEN  'otherticket'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "all_otherticket", 
    fm.uri AS "custom_full_img", 
    fm.uri AS "custom_thumbnail_img", 
    '' AS "image_placeholder", 
     task.task_id AS "task_id", 
    tc.color AS "priority",
     bo.bo_color AS "bo_color", 
     bo.business_unit AS "business_unit",
     bo.client_due_date AS "client_due_date",
    task.status AS "status", 
    task.task_display_name AS "task_display_name",

    users.name AS "assigned_to", 
    task.next_followup AS "task_next_followup", 
    task.task_start_date AS "task_start_date", 
    task.buffer_hrs AS "sla_hrs", 
    tc.elapsed_time AS "elapsed_hrs", 
    role_department_list.department AS "department", 
    role_department_list.sub_department AS "sub_department", 
    bo.json_data->>'category' AS "category",  

CASE WHEN (task.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND (CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER) AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER))) THEN bo.json_data->>'category' ELSE NULL END AS "category" ,

bo.json_data->>'season'  AS "season",
bo.json_data->>'program' AS "program",
bo.json_data->>'fabrication' AS "fabrication",
bo.json_data->>'design_details' AS "design_details",
bo.json_data->>'yarn_details' AS "yarn_details",
bo.json_data->>'composition' AS "composition",
bo.json_data->>'knitting' AS "knitting",
bo.json_data->>'finishing_details' AS "finishing_details",
bo.json_data->>'trim_details' AS "trim_details",
bo.json_data->>'loop_length' AS "loop_length",
bo.json_data->>'request_receipt_date' AS "request_receipt_date",
bo.json_data->>'customer_required_date' AS "customer_required_date",
bo.json_data->>'pi_date' AS "pi_date",
bo.json_data->>'stage' AS "stage",
bo.json_data->>'color' AS "data_color",
bo.json_data->>'brandix_t_a' AS "brandix_t_a",
bo.json_data->>'csbd_date' AS "csbd_date",
bo.json_data->>'batch_no'  AS "batch_no",
bo.json_data->>'item_code'  AS "item_code",
bo.json_data->>'quality'  AS "quality",


bo.json_data->>'buyer'  AS "buyer",
bo.json_data->>'mcode_won_number'  AS "mcode_won_number",
bo.json_data->>'ex_mill_date'  AS "ex_mill_date",
bo.json_data->>'garment_desc'  AS "garment_desc",
bo.json_data->>'matching_instruction'  AS "matching_instruction",
bo.json_data->>'fabric_description'  AS "fabric_description",
bo.json_data->>'dye_part'  AS "dye_part",
bo.json_data->>'shade'  AS "shade",
bo.json_data->>'internal_or_confirmed'  AS "internal_or_confirmed",

CASE when (CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed'
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
ELSE NULL
END) > task.buffer_hrs THEN CONCAT('a_bl', ':', 'Delayed') ELSE NULL end as "delayed_status",

CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed' 
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date)) 
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))

ELSE NULL
END AS elapsed_days,

user_full_name .field_full_name_value AS "assigned_user_name",
bo.bo_id  AS "initiative_id",
bo.json_data->>'due_date' AS "due_date",

EXTRACT(epoch FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(bo.json_data->>'customer_required_date', 'DD-Mon-YY')) as timestamp_cust_req

LEFT JOIN {task_color} as tc ON task.task_id = tc.task_id 
LEFT JOIN {users_field_data} as users ON task.assigned_uid = users.uid 
LEFT JOIN {process} as process ON task.pr_id = process.pr_id 
LEFT JOIN {business_object} as bo ON task.bo_id = bo.bo_id 
LEFT JOIN {file_managed} fm ON bo.bo_img_fid = fm.fid 
LEFT JOIN {role_department_list} as role_department_list ON task.sub_department = role_department_list.sub_department 
LEFT JOIN {user__field_full_name} AS user_full_name ON task.assigned_uid = user_full_name .entity_id

AND bo.business_unit IN (:business_unit[] ) 

ORDER BY CASE WHEN bo_color IS NULL OR bo_color  =  '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, bo_color ASC, buff_penetration_days DESC, bo.client_due_date ASC, task_id ASC

datatables_config.datatable_query:
SELECT issue.id AS "id", 
encode(CAST(CAST(issue.id AS TEXT) AS bytea), 'base64') AS "issue_encoded_id", 
 CASE
      WHEN issue.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid OR  issue.status = 'closed'  THEN 'View'
      WHEN issue.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid  AND issue.status <> 'closed' THEN 'Assign To Me'
      ELSE ''
      END AS "action_button",
 CASE
      WHEN issue.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid OR  issue.status = 'closed'  THEN 'redirect'
      WHEN issue.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid  AND issue.status <> 'closed' THEN 'assignIssue'
      ELSE ''
      END AS "custom_api_btn_action",
 CASE
      WHEN issue.assigned_uid !=  :assigned_uid OR  issue.status = 'closed' THEN CONCAT('view-issue/', encode(CAST(CAST(issue.id AS TEXT) AS bytea), 'base64'))
     WHEN issue.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid  AND issue.status <> 'closed' THEN  encode(CAST(CAST(issue.id AS TEXT) AS bytea), 'base64') 
     ELSE ''
     END AS "custom_api_btn_data",
CASE WHEN issue.escalation_level = 1 THEN 'Level 1'
     WHEN issue.escalation_level = 2 THEN 'Level 2'
     ELSE '' END AS "escalation_level",
 issue.title AS "title", 
issue.issue_description AS "description", 
role_department_list.sub_department AS "department", 
md.master_json->>'category' AS "category", 
issue.entity_id AS "entity_id", 
CONCAT('ticket-details/', issue.entity_id, '?destination=/issues') AS entity_id_link,

CASE
    WHEN 'hr' IN (:user_roles[]) THEN ''
    ELSE 'no-hyperlink-datatable'
END AS entity_id_link_classname,

task.bo_id AS "bo_id", 
INITCAP(issue.status) AS "status", 
issue.created AS "created_date", 
issue.updated AS "updated_date", 
issue.created_by AS "uid", 
u.field_full_name_value AS "created_user", 
issue.assigned_uid AS "assigned_uid", 
u1.field_full_name_value AS "assigned_user" ,


CASE WHEN issue.status = 'open' OR issue.status = 'awaiting_response'  THEN DATE_PART('day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(issue.created))
WHEN issue.status = 'closed' THEN DATE_PART('day', to_timestamp(issue.closed_on) - to_timestamp(issue.created))
WHEN issue.status = 'resolved' THEN DATE_PART('day', to_timestamp(issue.resolved_on) - to_timestamp(issue.created))
ELSE '0' END AS "elapsed_days",
task.task_display_name AS "task_display_name",
bo.bo_id  AS "initiative_id",
bo.json_data->>'initiative_type' AS "initiative_type" ,
bo.business_unit AS "business_unit"


FROM {issue_flow} issue 
JOIN {role_department_list} AS role_department_list ON issue.department = role_department_list.role 
LEFT JOIN {task} task ON issue.entity_id = task.task_id 
LEFT JOIN {business_object} AS bo ON task.bo_id = bo.bo_id 

JOIN {user__field_full_name} u ON issue.created_by = u.entity_id 
LEFT JOIN {user__field_full_name} u1 ON issue.assigned_uid = u1.entity_id  
LEFT JOIN {master_data_issue_category} md ON issue.category_id = md.id  


WHERE ((('administrator' IN (:user_roles[] )) OR ('wcms_admin' IN (:user_roles[] ))) OR ((issue.assigned_uid = :loggedIn_uid ) OR (issue.assigned_uid = :assigned_uid AND issue.department IN (:user_roles[] ))) OR
((issue.escalation_level = 1 AND md.master_json->>'escalation1_uid' = :loggedIn_uid ) OR (issue.escalation_level = 2 AND md.master_json->>'escalation2_uid' = :loggedIn_uid )))

  ORDER BY   action_button DESC, position(issue.status::text in 'open,awaiting input,resolved,closed'),  issue.escalation_level DESC,   issue.id DESC

SELECT 
CASE 
WHEN task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER) THEN 'Unsnooze'
ELSE 'Edit' END AS "action_button", 
CASE 
WHEN task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER) THEN ''
ELSE CONCAT('ticket-details/', task.task_id) END  AS "url_link", 
CASE 
WHEN task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER) THEN CONCAT('awake')
ELSE NULL END  AS "link", 
CASE
WHEN task.assigned_uid != :assigned_uid AND CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > CAST(:time as INTEGER) THEN 'Unsnooze'
ELSE '' END  AS "modal_link_name", 
fm.uri AS "custom_full_img", 
fm.uri AS "custom_thumbnail_img", 
'' AS "image_placeholder", 
task.status AS "status", 
task.task_id AS "task_id", 
task.created AS "created_date", 
task.task_start_date AS "task_start_date", 
task.buffer_hrs AS "sla_hrs", 
tc.elapsed_time AS "elapsed_hrs", 
tc.color AS "priority",
 tc.color AS "color",
bo.bo_color AS "bo_color", 
bo.business_unit AS "business_unit",
bo.client_due_date AS "client_due_date",
task.task_display_name AS "task_display_name", 
CONCAT('bo-details/', task.bo_id) AS "bo_id_link", 
task.bo_id AS "bo_id", 
task.next_followup AS "task_next_followup", 
bo.bo_id  AS "initiative_id",

bo.json_data->>'season'  AS "season",
bo.json_data->>'program' AS "program",
bo.json_data->>'fabrication' AS "fabrication",
bo.json_data->>'design_details' AS "design_details",
bo.json_data->>'yarn_details' AS "yarn_details",
bo.json_data->>'composition' AS "composition",
bo.json_data->>'knitting' AS "knitting",
bo.json_data->>'finishing_details' AS "finishing_details",
bo.json_data->>'trim_details' AS "trim_details",
bo.json_data->>'loop_length' AS "loop_length",
bo.json_data->>'request_receipt_date' AS "request_receipt_date",
bo.json_data->>'pi_date' AS "pi_date",
bo.json_data->>'customer_required_date' AS "customer_required_date",
bo.json_data->>'stage' AS "stage",
bo.json_data->>'color' AS "data_color",
bo.json_data->>'brandix_t_a' AS "brandix_t_a",
bo.json_data->>'csbd_date' AS "csbd_date",
bo.json_data->>'batch_no'  AS "batch_no",
bo.json_data->>'item_code'  AS "item_code",
bo.json_data->>'quality'  AS "quality",

bo.json_data->>'buyer'  AS "buyer",
bo.json_data->>'mcode_won_number'  AS "mcode_won_number",
bo.json_data->>'ex_mill_date'  AS "ex_mill_date",
bo.json_data->>'garment_desc'  AS "garment_desc",
bo.json_data->>'matching_instruction'  AS "matching_instruction",
bo.json_data->>'fabric_description'  AS "fabric_description",
bo.json_data->>'dye_part'  AS "dye_part",
bo.json_data->>'shade'  AS "shade",
bo.json_data->>'internal_or_confirmed'  AS "internal_or_confirmed",

CASE when (CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed'
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
ELSE NULL
END) > task.buffer_hrs THEN CONCAT('a_bl', ':', 'Delayed') ELSE NULL end as "delayed_status",



CASE 
     WHEN (CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) > :time ) THEN  'Followup Ticket'
     ELSE bo.json_data->>'category' 
    END AS "category_type", 
CASE 
     WHEN (CAST (task.next_followup as INTEGER) <= :time ) THEN  'ALL Current Ticket'
     ELSE NULL 
    END AS "all_category", 
user_full_name .field_full_name_value AS "assigned_user_name", 
task.tkt_code AS "ticket_code", 
role_department_list.sub_department AS "department", 
CASE WHEN task.close_button_on_list = '1' THEN 'Close' ELSE '' END AS "close_button_on_list" ,
CASE
WHEN task.status = 'closed' 
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(task.closed_on) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date)) 
WHEN task.status = 'open' AND CAST (task.task_start_date as INTEGER) < :time
THEN DATE_PART( 'day', to_timestamp(:time) - to_timestamp(task.task_start_date))
ELSE NULL
END AS elapsed_days,
bo.json_data->>'category' AS "category", 
bo.json_data->>'due_date' AS "due_date",

EXTRACT(epoch FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(bo.json_data->>'request_receipt_date', 'DD-Mon-YY')) as timestamp_req,
EXTRACT(epoch FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(bo.json_data->>'customer_required_date', 'DD-Mon-YY')) as timestamp_cust_req


FROM {task} AS task 
LEFT JOIN {task_color} AS tc ON task.task_id = tc.task_id 
LEFT JOIN {users_field_data} AS users ON task.created_by = users.uid 
LEFT JOIN {process} AS process ON task.pr_id = process.pr_id 
LEFT JOIN {business_object} AS bo ON task.bo_id = bo.bo_id 
LEFT JOIN {file_managed} fm ON bo.bo_img_fid = fm.fid 
JOIN {role_department_list} AS role_department_list ON task.sub_department= role_department_list.sub_department
LEFT JOIN {user__field_full_name} AS user_full_name ON task.assigned_uid = user_full_name .entity_id 
WHERE task.assigned_uid = :loggedIn_uid AND task.status = 'open' AND bo.bo_status = 'active' AND process.process_status <> 80 AND task.display_flag = 1 AND CAST(task.task_start_date as INTEGER) <= CAST(:time as INTEGER)  
ORDER BY CASE WHEN bo_color IS NULL OR bo_color =  '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, bo_color , buff_penetration_days DESC,  bo.client_due_date ASC, elapsed_days DESC
